checks.name: App and native-fixture inputs match previously tested snapshot

currentFilesPrivacyAudit.scope: Known local identifiers, personal commit emails, and bounded high-confidence credential patterns; not a guarantee against every possible secret.
currentFilesPrivacyAudit.fileSelection: Git tracked files and unignored candidate files. Ignored build products and Xcode xcuserdata are excluded.

historyScope: The file audit excludes .git. The original repository history is preserved and still includes older author emails and local paths.
validationScope: Fresh local tests and model/icon/PNG verification after retaining the cleaned asset set. Existing native checks are reused only for their byte-identical recorded inputs. Main-branch hosted builds run through GitHub Actions after the push.
